run_evaluate_qualification: run the evaluate_qualification CLI tool with --gold_set, --worker_file, and --worker_stats_out arguments
read_gold_set: read a gold answer set file and compile allowed answers into a defaultdict of sets
compare_dicts: compare an action dictionary against an allowed dictionary to check if the answer matches
get_wrong_stats: get statistics on which keys differ between a worker answer and the gold answer
evaluate_workers: evaluate worker annotation answers against the gold set and compute per-worker accuracy percentages
